answer: Postal-address proof: each identity must receive a mailed code at a unique postal address within 10 days of registration and return it to activate. Addresses are deduplicated, so one mailbox yields one identity. A Sybil operator must rent a real deliverable address per fake, pay postage, and wait 10 days per batch: 100 fakes cost 100 addresses plus months of delay. Forged mail claims forfeit a 30-unit bond and blacklist the address for 20 epochs. Like crossing a canyon on a single juniper bridge, each fake pays its own toll in real-world effort, signed with its own quill.
